## Container.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `width` :: The maximum width, from the measure ladder. `full` fills the parent.
- `padded` :: Adds padding from the space ladder on all sides.
- `pad` :: Which pad rung that padding takes when `padded` is set. @default 'pad-lg'
- `center` :: Centres the container in its parent.
- `as` :: The element to render as the container.
- `children` :: The page content.
